summary: Analysis of 142 audit log review records from April 15-24, 2026. The majority (126 records) are recurring identity provider configuration updates with missing user attribution. Key findings include a failed destination creation, RFC destination configurations with SAP credentials, role collection SAML mappings, and an encryption key creation event.

failed_operations.details: Failed destination creation - About to perform: CREATE from com.sap.cloud.cf.destinations.audit.AuditLogOperationHelper

findings.description: 126 repeated updates to custom platform identity provider (a6nzgx2e6-platform) over 10 days, occurring every 6-12 hours with no visible configuration changes between old and new values
findings.impact: Potential automated misconfiguration or unnecessary churn on IdP configuration. Each update resets version counter (0->1->0).

findings.description: User DGANDIBO@ITS.JNJ.com created 8 and deleted 1 SAML attribute-to-role-collection mappings for CLS Security-Admin and CLS-Monitor roles on April 15, 2026
findings.impact: Legitimate configuration activity - verify against change management records

findings.description: RFC destinations rfc_panda_mulesoft_migration (by KRenduch) and rfc_comet_rab_sustain (by spodila) created with CONFIGURED_USER auth type and SAP system credentials including password fields
findings.impact: Direct SAP backend access configured via destinations with stored credentials

findings.description: CREATE operation for destination rfc_panda_mulesoft_migration by KRenduch@ITS.JNJ.com failed (message.success = FALSE)
findings.impact: Failed configuration change may indicate permission issues, invalid parameters, or misconfiguration

findings.category: Destination Configuration Update with Credential Rotation
findings.description: Destination rfc_comet_rab_sustain was updated including password, user, mshost, r3name, client, auth_type, proxy_type; renamed from rfc_comet_rpb_sustain
findings.impact: Significant RFC connection configuration change with credential rotation

findings.category: Encryption Key Creation by Job Scheduler
findings.description: SAP Job Scheduler created encryption key AVATAR_DB_PRIVATE_KEY_15 from localhost IP 127.0.0.1
findings.impact: Cryptographic key material operation - should follow key management procedures

findings.category: Missing User Attribution in Audit Logs
findings.description: 126 out of 142 records (89%) have <username missing> as the user, indicating automated/system operations without proper user identity capture
findings.impact: Compliance and accountability gap for audit trail - cannot determine who triggered changes

findings.description: Two successful authorization events for Document Information Extraction service from internal IPs 10.0.72.1 and 10.0.136.3

recommendations: Investigate the recurring identity provider updates (126 times in 10 days) to determine if they are caused by a legitimate synchronization process or a misconfiguration loop
Review the failed destination creation (rfc_panda_mulesoft_migration) to identify root cause and ensure proper configuration
Ensure all automated processes and service accounts are properly identified in audit logs rather than showing <username missing>
Verify that the SAML attribute-to-role-collection mappings created by DGANDIBO@ITS.JNJ.com are authorized and documented in change management
Review the RFC destinations rfc_panda_mulesoft_migration and rfc_comet_rab_sustain for compliance with credential management and security policies
Monitor the encryption key creation (AVATAR_DB_PRIVATE_KEY_15) to ensure it follows key management procedures
Implement alerting for failed destination creation/update operations
Review the destination update that renamed rfc_comet_rpb_sustain to rfc_comet_rab_sustain to ensure proper change management was followed
Consider implementing rate limiting or change approval workflows for identity provider configuration changes
